test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What will be the amount payable on maturity if Rs. 2,000 is invested for a period of three years at 30% p.a. interest compounded yearly?
solution:
Given:

Principal amount (P)= Rs. 2000

Rate of interest (R)= 30% p.a.

Time (N) = 3 years

Concept used:

Compound interest, CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Amount payable on the maturity

⇒ 2000(1 + 30/100)³ 

⇒ 2000 × 1.3³

⇒ 2000 × 2.197

⇒ Rs. 4394

**∴ Rs. 4394 will be the amount payable on maturity if Rs. 2,000 is invested for a period of three years at 30% p.a. interest compounded yearly.**
